name: Goa Beach Holiday
description: Relax on pristine sandy beaches, enjoy water sports, and experience lively coastal culture.

name: Manali Snow Retreat
description: Breathtaking snowy peaks, scenic valleys, Solang valley adventures, and cozy mountain stays.

name: Royal Jaipur Heritage
description: Discover grand forts, magnificent palaces, vibrant bazaars, and royal Rajasthani hospitality.

name: Kerala Backwaters & Tea
description: Serene houseboat cruises through Alleppey backwaters and lush green tea estates of Munnar.

name: Rishikesh River Rafting
description: Thrilling white water rafting on the Ganges, cliff jumping, bungee jumping, and riverside camping.

name: Ladakh High Passes
description: Traverse high altitude mountain passes, Pangong Lake, Nubra Valley, and ancient monasteries.

name: Andaman Island Escape
description: Crystal-clear turquoise waters, Radhanagar beach, scuba diving, and coral reef exploration.

name: Kaziranga Wildlife Safari
description: Explore dense jungles and spot the famous one-horned rhinoceros on jeep and elephant safaris.
